about: The BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit from spec/**/*.md; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

rules.title: The AI starts only for a level with HasAI, on the server

rules.title: The AI's settings come from seven shared partitions

rules.title: One Kynapse world per pathfinding type the level lists

evidence.ref: every working AI level read lists mp_common's two PathfindingSettings in LevelData and every stock MP level has the array empty (STOCK_MP_AI_PLAN 12.1); the generator settings are found at LevelData+0x36C as an array of PathfindingSettings pointers; the set-up's per-type load was not traced instruction by instruction
PathfindingTypes infantry + vehicles on Napisal's ONS_MP_005GR, ONS_MP_002, ONS_MP_004, DICE's Xbox ONS_MP_002 and SP_004_B; empty on every stock MP level read

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe world capacity at 0x00F025EC (C7 46 08 01), registry refusal 0x0109E930; generator driver 0x00F299A0 with no caller in .text; Kaim::CMapBuilder licence request for feature CMapBuilder (error -1,359), 2026-10-14

evidence.ref: stock MP levels compared (all launch MP levels, identical on Xbox 360): HasAI false, no PathfindingTypes, no SpawnPointManager; path data only for the 13 campaign levels; MP_002: 1 AI spawner, disabled, 0 AreaOrder, 0 PatrolOrder
